title: cassinia straminea
intro: Cassinia straminea, commonly known as the stramy cassinia or stramy bush, is a flowering plant species in the family Asteraceae. This plant is traditionally used in Australian and New Zealand folk medicine, where it is valued for its health benefits, particularly in treating skin conditions such as eczema and acne. The health benefits of Cassinia straminea are attributed to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which are believed to be effective in reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents responsible for the therapeutic actions of Cassinia straminea include sesquiterpene lactones, triterpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which have been shown to possess antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
